scenario: generate an end-to-end deterministic PyTorch training and export pipeline for room occupancy detection under contract-driven development split constraints
user_visible_goal: Produce stable holdout predictions, metrics, confusion matrix, training history, and a reproducible model bundle from UCI Occupancy Detection data.

selected_skill.name: pytorch-patterns
selected_skill.risk_screening: No external account, cloud credential, private API, or privileged operation dependency; focuses on local PyTorch engineering workflow.

skill_hypothesis.with_skill: The solver is more likely to produce deterministic device-agnostic training code, obey contract-driven validation partitioning, and implement complete bundle export/reload behavior with a CPU-safe PyTorch state_dict workflow.
skill_hypothesis.without_skill: The solver is more likely to stop at a partially working baseline and miss one or more action-level requirements such as contract-driven split handling, deterministic rerun, or bundle reload consistency.

main_tests: Validate required outputs and schema contract.
Recompute holdout metrics from predictions and ensure consistency.
Enforce contract-driven validation partitioning over the development pool.
Reload exported bundle on CPU and reproduce holdout predictions.
Require the submitted pipeline to clear the holdout quality threshold.
guardrails: Mutate the split contract and require validation partition metadata to change accordingly.
Append transport tail beyond sequence_length and require predictions to remain unchanged.
Require deterministic repeated runs on identical input.

data_provenance.service_source: Single-container local runtime with pre-generated local snapshot; no external account dependency.
